summary: Reports that the U.S. and Iran are nearing a deal — including a moratorium on nuclear enrichment — drove a broad equity rally Wednesday, sending the S&P 500 and Nasdaq to fresh record closes. Oil dropped roughly 6% on peace optimism, though analysts warn that even if the Strait of Hormuz reopens, a full recovery in shipping and trade flows is expected to take several weeks.
tweet: Iran peace signals sent stocks to record highs and oil plunging 6%, but the Fed stays on hold with CPI at 3.3% — risk is on while the macro overhang lingers.
